design_concept: A creative, neo-brutalist portfolio that breaks out of the standard 'boring developer' mold. It uses high-contrast borders, solid drop shadows (offset by 4px or 8px), large display typography, and a vibrant color palette to stand out. Micro-interactions and hover states should feel tactile and physical. The entire site uses a single-page scrolling structure with smooth 'Lenis' momentum scrolling.

headings.usage: Use Black/Heavy weights. Tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em). Never center by default. Left-aligned or intentionally broken alignment.

body.usage: Clean, readable, slightly geometric to balance the brutalist headers.

mono_accents.usage: Used for overlines, small tech stack tags, and subtle developer 'easter eggs'.

components_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID). Generous gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical column spans.
components_and_layout.borders_and_shadows: Neo-Brutalism style. Use solid 2px borders (`border-2 border-[#0F0F0F]`). Shadows must be solid, unblurred offsets, e.g., `box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px #0F0F0F`. On hover, translate elements `-translate-x-1 -translate-y-1` and increase shadow to `box-shadow: 10px 10px 0px #0F0F0F`.
components_and_layout.buttons: Large, blocky, highly tactile. Vibrant background (e.g. #FFD700), 2px solid black border, and solid black drop shadow. On hover, the button depresses (translates down/right) and shadow reduces, creating a physical 'click' feel.
components_and_layout.cards: Square or rectangular with zero border-radius (`rounded-none` or `rounded-md` max) to maintain the brutalist feel. Background colors rotate between Off-White, Pale Mint, and Butter Yellow.
components_and_layout.marquee: Use an infinite marquee for the Skills section. Massive outline text (`text-8xl font-black text-transparent [-webkit-text-stroke:2px_#0F0F0F]`).

sections.Header: Sticky, floating nav. Transparent background but with a solid black bottom border or housed in a pill-shaped container with neo-brutalist styling. Links to About, Skills, Experience, Projects. Right side: 'Download Resume' prominent button.
sections.Hero: Massive text 'SARTHAK SAHU'. Subtext: 'Full Stack Developer / Digital Builder'. Asymmetrical layout featuring the 3D claymorphism avatar floating/rotating slightly. A vibrant Call to Action to 'Say Hello'.
sections.About: Large, statement typography layout. Not a boring paragraph. Use highlighting (`bg-[#FFD700]`) on key words like 'React', 'New Delhi', '5+ Years'.
sections.Skills: Kinetic texture marquee. Continuous scrolling ribbon of tech stacks (React, Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, HubSpot) separated by asterisks or playful icons.
sections.Experience: A zigzag or step-based timeline. Left column: Year/Company (MediaTek, NGO). Right column: Thick black borders enclosing the role and impact. High contrast.
sections.Projects: Bento grid of featured projects. Large thumbnail images with hover zoom effects. Solid color background blocks that change color on hover. Include links to live/github.
sections.Contact: Massive typography footer: 'LET S BUILD SOMETHING'. Two massive buttons: Mailto and WhatsApp. Social links (LinkedIn, GitHub) in a structured footer below. No contact forms.

motion_and_interactions.custom_cursor: A custom circular cursor (`w-6 h-6 bg-[#FF4500] mix-blend-difference rounded-full`) that scales up on interactive elements.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Physical buttons (translate down/right, shadow decreases). Links get a thick animated underline. Images zoom in slightly within their containers.
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered slide-up and fade-in for bento grid cards (framer-motion). Text lines reveal from bottom (masking).

images.description: MediaTek project representation - pop art microchips
NGO Management Platform representation - community connection

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for UI icons (Menu, ArrowUpRight, Download). Use 'react-icons/fi' or 'react-icons/fa' for specific brand logos (React, Next.js, HubSpot, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, GitHub).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure black (#0F0F0F) text on vibrant backgrounds passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media queries by disabling framer-motion variants.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid to all CTA buttons, project links, and social links.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Set up Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main Layout/App component.
Implement the Neo-brutalist shadow utility in tailwind.config.js (e.g., `boxShadow: { 'brutal': '6px 6px 0px #0F0F0F', 'brutal-hover': '2px 2px 0px #0F0F0F' }`).
Import Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, and IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Create a custom Cursor component that tracks mouse position and uses framer-motion for smooth lagging.
Build the Marquee using `react-fast-marquee` or pure CSS animation.
Use standard `<a>` tags with `mailto:email@example.com` and `https://wa.me/PhoneNumber` for contact actions.
Ensure 'Download Resume' opens the `/resume.pdf` (assumed file path) in a new tab or triggers download.
